parameters.content:
# Izende AI Website Builder — Stage 2

Polls Supabase for pending leads, generates a single-file HTML preview with Anthropic, deploys it through izendestudioweb.com/api/preview-deploy.php, updates Supabase, and emails the prospect.

Before activation, set n8n variables/credentials for SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, PREVIEW_DEPLOY_SECRET, and verify Brevo SMTP credential.
